changes: Fixed targeting and focus for players with surnames on WoW Forever. Nearby sightings, bounties and battleground rows now use the full player name.
Nearby now starts enabled in Highground with five rows and quiet sighting alerts. Existing choices are kept; use `/hg nearby on` if it was previously off.
Panel cogwheels stay reachable while locked and in Frameless mode. Compact battleground columns share a cog on the first visible panel.
notice: Restart WoW after updating Highground, Arena, Battlegrounds, Bounties or Nearby; new panel-control files require it. Macros-only updates need /reload. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
